rowsPerPageMobile.declared: On mobile, the same Dropdown, at the start of the strip: Figma draws it anew there, out of the desktop strip's container, and the shell draws the caller's one Dropdown in whichever the breakpoint draws.

iconButton.declared: On mobile the action is the caller's SOLAR Icon Button (md, square, primary), where desktop draws a Button: two components, so two slots the caller fills by breakpoint.

Decided once here, as the paddings are.

docs.description: Footer strip for Table — row count and pagination on the left, an optional action on the right. 2 variants: breakpoint (desktop, mobile). showButton toggles the trailing Button. Part of the Data Table pattern; sits directly under Table.

rules.reason: The strip under a Table, as the description says: how many rows a page shows (the caller's Dropdown, with its words on desktop), the caller's Pagination, and an optional action (a Button on desktop, an Icon Button on mobile), spread across it. Bespoke on both platforms, drawn with the shared layer helpers, each part the caller's SOLAR component. The breakpoint is the app's to give (owner decision 2026-09-25). Paging itself is the caller's.
On desktop the strip holds one container, centred, which spreads its parts; on mobile the strip spreads its parts itself, as Figma draws each.
